t.E263.agn: In 1973 JECFA set the ADI for calcium acetate as 'not limited'.
t.E263.body: Acetate is a compound involved in the body's normal metabolism.
t.E263.eval: The calcium salt of acetic acid (the acid in vinegar); acetate is involved in the body's normal metabolism. In 1973 JECFA set the ADI as 'not limited'.
t.E263.found.0: May be used in many foods in the EU at quantum satis (as much as needed)
t.E263.prod: Obtained by neutralising acetic acid with calcium hydroxide; acetic acid may be produced by fermentation or chemical synthesis.
t.E263.regx.1: Group I additive; generally authorised at quantum satis (as much as needed).
t.E263.summary: The calcium salt of acetic acid. It is used as an acidity regulator, preservative and firming agent.
t.E263.what: It is the calcium salt of acetic acid and is used as a preservative and acidity regulator.
